title: Designability of RNA Targets with Up to Two Length-2 Helices
description: Lean 4 formalization and reproducibility materials for universal unique designability in the four-letter Watson-Crick maximum-base-pair model for RNA targets with up to two length-2 helices. Includes the manuscript source, verified examples, and release audits.
